title: Chapter 258: Rule-Level Power Intervention
content:
Chapter 258: Rule-Level Power Intervention

The Zerg army's siege was fought slowly, but the reinforcements from the alien race were not coming, which surprised the observers from all parties.

The alien race's style of action has always been very strong. They suffered a loss at the hands of the Zerg, and it was unreasonable not to get back at them immediately.

The area around the 66th city has become the sphere of influence of the alien race because of the strong sweep of the alien race's own army.

Not long after the Zerg army wiped out the alien race's own army, it would take time for the armies of various races in the local camp to recapture this area.

The Zerg army marched quickly and ran all the way here. For example, the 200,000 elite troops of the Ox tribe set out with the Zerg army and should be halfway now.

The armies of other races, affected by various factors, could not keep up with the pace of the Zerg army even if they wanted to enter this area.

It can be said that the Zerg army is now alone and deep into the sphere of influence of the alien race.

It is very strange that the aliens did not help when attacking the aliens' city in the sphere of influence of the aliens.

Wu Qing hatched a group of Zerg hosts in the Zerg base and sent them to the 66th city for reconnaissance.

This reconnaissance really found the problem!

The aliens were not silent, but were quietly gathering heavy troops towards the 66th city.

The movement was not big, but the assembled troops were very large.

All the strongholds in the wild in this area were occupied by the aliens' army. They hid silently, as if waiting for orders.

If it were not for the powerful reconnaissance ability of the Zerg hosts, this situation might not be detected.

After reconnaissance of the movements of the alien army, Wu Qing was relieved and prepared to end the siege as soon as possible and began to build a powerful defense system for the 66th city to meet the attack of the alien army.

Now with the support of the Zerg base, there is no need to worry about more enemies coming.

With Wu Qing's order, the Zerg army speeded up the cleaning of the underground bunkers in the city, and the Zerg puppies began to join the cleaning team.

The alien army in the underground bunkers was desperately slaughtered by the Zerg army.

When the sun rose again, the cleaning work of the 66th city was nearing its end. A large number of alien city defense troops were trapped underground and turned into system resources in the attack of the Zerg army.

"This position in the city is a bit abnormal. It seems that a rule-level force interferes with the perception of the Zerg host!"

"I just sensed a trace of special energy fluctuations there. I will send Zerg puppies to check it out!"

"The situation there is unclear now. The Zerg army must leave that area first!"

Wu Qing was preparing to deal with the siege of the alien army, and the Queen of Zerg suddenly reported a special situation to him.

"Is there still a problem in the city? Use rule-level power to cover it up. It seems that something big is going to happen!"

"The Zerg army will withdraw to the safe zone to organize defense first, let the Zerg puppies come out, and ambush the whole city first!"

Wu Qing made a quick decision to withdraw the Zerg army on the ground to the area covered by the Zerg base. In this area, not only is there the protection of the Zerg territory, but it is safe from the sky to the ground.

In the Zerg base that was expanded again, a large number of Zerg puppies quietly entered various locations in the 66th city through the underground passages opened by the Zerg worker bees in the city, and hid underground.

Soon, tens of millions of Zerg puppies were all over the city. Except for the area where the queen sensed abnormalities, other places were completely controlled by the Zerg.

After thinking about it, Wu Qing hatched 300 Zerg queens and 120 Zerg explosive mosquitoes, and upgraded them all to five-star.

The number of five-star Zerg queens in the Zerg army increased to 500, and the number of five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes increased to 200.

The aliens have to compete with each other in terms of strength. After the Zerg has a base, they have enough Zerg dogs and are no longer afraid of the enemy's numerical advantage.

What we need to be careful about is the various powerful arms of the aliens, such as high-star human mages, human priests and human knights. Such forces are sometimes enough to change the situation.

The role of Zerg queens is irreplaceable. Of course, the more the better, but their resource consumption is much greater than other arms. If they increase their number, the system's resources will reach the bottom.

Wu Qing hatched another 500 three-star Zerg queens. In the war, they are very good for releasing traps. In an emergency, they can continue to upgrade, allowing them to have the ability to kill strong people in a short time.

The Zerg army quickly withdrew to the area near the mountains of the 66th city, and built a defensive position with 50,000 Zerg destroyers as the center.

"How did the Zerg army gather its forces and build a defense line in the city?"

"Did they discover something?"

"The intelligence I got from my tribe shows that the alien army has already gathered here, and another war will start here!"

"The Zerg army is now alone in the city, occupying the city alone, the situation is a bit bad!"

"This time I want to see which races have the courage and strength to participate in the war here!"

"The Bull Tribe is the fastest, and some other races are taking action, but they may not be able to catch up with this war!"

"Even if they join the war, it won't be of much use. It still depends on whether the three powerful tribes that are now doing well are willing to come and get involved!"

"..."

Following the movements of the Tianwai human army, all forces became aware of their intentions, and they discovered that a war here was inevitable.

This chapter is not over, please click on the next page to continue reading!

…

A small group of Zerg puppies, under the personal control of the Zerg Queen, entered the abnormal area of City 66.

The Zerg puppy soon discovered that there is a huge underground space underground here, but the Zerg host has never discovered it. This shows that the rule-level power is powerful, and it is likely to be the power of the gods.

"It's the power of the gods again that directly converts the followers of the gods into resources. This is really hateful!"

Wu Qing is self-aware, and the system's ability to convert matter into energy can easily attract the attention of the various gods in the evil god camp.

The Lord of Light whom the humans outside the world believe in has had tens of millions of believers completely disappear in a short period of time. This is definitely intolerable.

As long as they have the support of gods, those believers will become more powerful and ferocious, and all kinds of tricks will emerge in endlessly.

The Zerg puppy entered the hidden snow area, which was filled with extremely rich light energy. Before the Zerg puppy had time to see clearly what was inside, the light energy completely exploded!

"boom……!"

There was a loud noise, and endless white light shot out from the underground space. The entire ground was opened by light energy, revealing a huge underground space.

A huge light attribute energy shield covered the entire underground space.

In the underground space, a large number of troops from the outer human race began to appear!

The troops of the Tianwai Human Tribe, all equipped with white equipment, lined up neatly and quickly filled up the entire underground space.

The extremely rich light energy in the underground space continues to overflow and infect the surrounding space, slowly turning the entire 66th City into a world of light!

The Zerg army, which was extremely adaptable, felt a little bit of discomfort.

At the same time, the armies of various races from the outer world gathered around the 66th City were rushing towards the 66th City at full speed.

"These humans from outside the world are so willing to spend money! They actually consume the power of the evil god like this!"

"Under the cover of the evil god's power, they actually built a space transmission channel in the city! They want to fight the Zerg army to the death at all costs!"

"These evil gods hate others sacrificing their believers. The Zerg army must sacrifice when they go to the battlefield. This angers the Lord of Light!"

"Faced with the Terran Human Army in this state, the armies of all the major tribes will choose to avoid the edge temporarily. Let's see how the Zerg chooses this time!"

"The Tianwai human army gathered around here must be on their way over. If this encirclement is formed, the Zerg army will not be able to escape!"

"It depends on whether the strong ones of the Zerg tribe will choose to take action at the critical moment. If the strong ones take action, the scale of this war will be even larger!"

"As soon as the Zerg entered the scene, they caused such a big thing. I don't know if it's good or bad!"

"..."

Observers from all forces in the local camp began to worry about the situation of the Zerg army.

The human army outside the sky stayed silently within the light barrier. They must not be afraid of the Zerg army taking action first. They were waiting for the surrounding armies to encircle them.

The Zerg puppy came to the light shield and tried a test attack. Not only did it have no effect, it was also damaged by light energy.

Through the Zerg host, Wu Qing saw countless human armies from outside the world. In addition to the largest number of goblins, the number of star-level troops of other races was also very large.

In addition, in the middle of the 66th city, the Tianwai Human Race directly built an unbreakable space transmission channel, and a large number of the elite troops of the Tianwai Human Race directly faced the Zerg army.

The location of the Zerg base is not far from the space transmission channel of the outer human race, and is already within the range of the Zerg Hydralisks.

The long-range troops of the Tianwai human army can attack the Zerg army by standing in the light shield.

This is very detrimental to the Zerg army, which has an absolute advantage in ultra-long-range firepower. This position cannot be arranged like this.

The Zerg army continued to move toward the mountains. The large army had already reached outside the walls of the 66th city, and was out of the range of the Tianwai human crossbowmen.

In the underground Zerg base, the hatching of Zerg puppies has been suspended. Zerg destroyers, Zerg hydralisers, Zerg cockroaches and Zerg stealth spiders are hatching rapidly.

They pass through various underground passages urgently opened by the Zerg worker bees and lurk underground under the Zerg army, waiting for orders to join the war.

The changes in the strength of the Zerg army should not be exposed for the time being. If they are revealed after the war begins, the Terrans can be caught off guard.

If the fact that the Zerg army can continuously increase its troops is exposed early, the Tianwai human army will be prepared and may find other ways to deal with it, which will be detrimental to the Zerg army.
